platform: Windows, macOS or Linux with an installed Chromium browser
export_requirements: Google Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge; executable on PATH, in a standard installation directory, or selected by MAZE_BROWSER
Arial is used when available; font substitution can change text layout and rasterization
